operations.name: assemble
operations.help: Assemble the candidate manifest's local components into a portable CLI definition with independent state scopes.

operations.name: activate
operations.help: Activate the candidate CLI definition, or import a named definition or interface export.

operations.name: enter
operations.help: Enter an interface context by identity; / selects root and .. selects parent.

operations.name: discover
operations.help: Inspect active context, commands, simulated state, connected read requirements and grants, and the last historical outcome.

operations.name: tree
operations.help: Print the active CLI contexts and verbs as a tree with required parameter types and binding labels.

operations.name: invoke
operations.help: Invoke a local command or qualified context-id/word; success records an explicitly simulated result or a granted JSON file observation. Exact receipt replay does not refresh observations.

operations.name: export-interface
operations.help: Create a portable export retaining active definition, simulated state, and labeled outcomes.
